Vendored from [floooh/sokol](https://github.com/floooh/sokol) at commit
`c24221dc065f34b26c6abd7b9194182120dba140` (see `REVISION`).
The headers are unmodified and distributed under the included zlib `LICENSE`.
`sokol_gl.h` comes from upstream's `util/` directory.

All headers must be updated together from a single revision. Builds use these
checked-in files and do not download dependencies or require the SDL SDK/DLL.
